newsitem.title: USA: Ultrak Inc to buy Monitor Dynamics Inc.
newsitem.headline: Ultrak Inc to buy Monitor Dynamics Inc.

text.p: Ultrak Inc said it signed a letter of intent to buy all the stock of Monitor Dynamics Inc, a privately-held California-based company that designs, manufactures and sells high-end security and access control systems.
A statement from Ultrak said the transaction is valued at about $25 million in cash.
Monitor is expected to have sales of over $12 million and pre-tax profits of over $3.5 million for its fiscal year ending March 31, the statement said.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of January, the statement said.
